description:
Only for a business whose card shows `live_data` (its items come from its connected Shopify or Square,
not from a page read). For a product: the platform’s stock right now — `state: confirmed | refuted |
unknown` (unknown = the platform does not track stock, which is not «no»). For a service on a platform
with bookings: the free `slots` between `from` and `to` (default: the next 7 days), each with a
`start_at` that book_slot takes as it is — on the business’s own clock with its offset
(`timezone` names the zone; `start_at_utc` is the same instant). If the card’s `cannot` lists `book`,
the slots are information only and the answer says so. A business without a connection answers `not_connected`.

business_id.description: the business id from the card

from.description: slots: the window’s start, ISO with an offset

offering_id.description: the offering id from the card

quantity.description: how many — stock is judged against it

to.description: slots: the window’s end, ISO with an offset

variant_id.description: the variant (the card lists them when there are several)

name: check_availability
title: Ask the business’s own system: is it in stock now · which slots are free
